text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered HIGH: gpu-memory-pressure on cluster=pool-prod-gpu-us-west-2 node=gpu-node-17 - >90% alloc failures, 12 tasks affected
emily: acked. I'm taking first look — paging Raj for CUDA-side checks :pagerduty-bot: @raj can you pick this up?
pagerduty-bot: incident assigned to emily, escalation to raj if not acknowledged in 2m
raj: on it. pulling logs now, hitting the node via ssh. are we seeing a model rollout or traffic spike?
emily: metrics show steady qps but token-lat dist shifted up 2x last 10m. kvcache miss rate climbed. could be a KV-cache growth causing OOM.
raj: running nvidia-smi and dmesg now. attaching quick snapshot:
```
raj: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
raj: GPU0, 24GB, used=23.1GB\nraj: dmesg | tail -n 20 -> NVRM: Xid (DMA) 79, GPU memory allocation failed
```
emily: confirmed Xid 79s. escalate to sre-lead if we need host-level intervention. Jordan flag for customer-impact assessment?
jordan: seeing ~8 customer requests failing with 429 / model-serve OOM on the tail. Not all customers, looks like affected model variants: rwd-bert-13b-quant and rwd-13b-fp16.
raj: quick mitigation: reduce batch size and drain new requests from gpu-node-17 to other nodes. i'll toggle autoshedder policy to force fallback to cpu for low-priority routes for 5m.
emily: do it. commands?
raj: patch route config ->
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap autoshedder --patch '{"data":{"cpu_fallback_routes":"/search,/async-embed"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment autoshedder
```
raj: also cordon node to prevent new pods landing: kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
emily: cordoned. starting graceful evict of pods on that node.
SRE-lead: loop me in on the logs if eviction fails. watch for pod crashloop from OOM killer.
raj: evictions in progress. 6/8 pods terminated gracefully, two restarted on other GPU nodes. one pod hit immediate OOM during shutdown, collecting its stack.
jordan: customer-impact: affected sessions mainly long-context chat and rerank jobs hitting >8k tokens. short gen endpoints unaffected. flagging two customers on SLA watch, support notified.
emily: marking incident state=mitigated for now since pressure dropped after drain and CPU fallback. keep monitoring for 30m.
raj: follow-up: diagnostics indicate a KV-cache retention bug where prefix eviction didn't run under certain seqlen heuristics; opened issue INFR-1723. temp mitigation suggested: tighten kv-ttl and lower in-memory cache limit.
raj: propose config change: set KV_CACHE_TTL=600 and KV_CACHE_MAX_ITEMS=200000 per node. rolling change across pool-prod-gpu.
sre-lead: +1 schedule rollout with canary of 1 node then 10% then full. Plan included in INFR-1723. Add a regression test for long-seq eviction.
jordan: support comms drafted: "We experienced transient GPU memory pressure impacting long-context workloads; traffic was routed to CPU fallback and pod drain to restore stability. No data loss. We're rolling a fix and will follow up with postmortem"
emily: handing off to night oncall at 2005012400 — @raj please own the rollout and postmortem notes. tagging pagerduty-bot to close if stable.
pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by emily; status=mitigated; awaiting confirmation before close.
raj: will run canary rollout now and monitor metrics (kv-miss, alloc-fail). posting updates in INFR-1723.
emily: thanks team. leaving thread open until last_message_ts. :thumbsup:
